pages.text: A new trait of advantage s in a population of N fixes with chance (1 - e^(-2s)) / (1 - e^(-4Ns)) (Kimura). Weak selection (4Ns << 1) leaves it to drift, p = 1/2N; strong selection drives it to about 2s.
$(thing)Set$(): Selection strength, Population size.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Founder effect: the chance varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too hard a pressure: the culture dies.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A trait that fixes surely is faster.
